column1: # Prebuilt binaries fetched from GitHub releases into ~/.local/bin.
#   name     command name, and the step id becomes `tool:<name>`
#   ref      the upstream release tag, VERBATIM. Some projects prefix it with
#            `v` and some do not, so storing the tag itself avoids a column for
#            the prefix -- {VERSION} below is just `ref` with a leading `v`
#            stripped. `latest` means resolve at install time (deliberate float).
#   min      lowest version our configs actually work with, or `-`. Enforced
#            when ref=latest; recorded as a contract either way.
#   install  bin:<names>  install these binaries into ~/.local/bin
# Why ~/.local/bin and not apt: it comes before /usr/bin in zsh/.zshenv, so a
# pinned copy here shadows any distro package without sudo. Several of these are
# only in apt on this machine via the third-party debian.griffo.io repo, which a
# fresh install would not have -- fetching them here is what makes the two match.
# Bump every ref with `bs.sh update`, review the diff, then commit.
